citations.claim: cart exceeds track at first violating step
cart already near end 4 steps earlier moving outward
pole still upright so controller prioritized balance over position

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise to 0, keeping all other fields identical; drift disappears and no violation in 374 steps

explanation: No pushes; seeded sensor noise (0.00537) corrupts state feedback. Controller keeps pole upright (theta ~-0.08 at step 374, margin 0.718) with tiny forces (~0.7 vs 51.8 limit) but allows slow cart random-walk drift negative (x -0.09 at step 0, -0.69 at step 200, -2.02 at step 350, -2.40 at step 374). Without cart-position correction authority under noisy measurements it walks off the -2.4 end. Zeroing noise removes failure. Frames confirm cart at left end with pole still near-upright.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.405 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart sits near the left end of the track while its pole remains nearly upright. Across steps 371 to 374 it stays pinned at that left edge without falling over.
